remarks: The Ultimate Canvas on the Cul-de-Sac: Shine Bright in the Village Corridor! Tucked away on one of the neighborhood's most coveted, postcard-worthy cul-de-sacs, this rare gem serves up the ultimate blend of peaceful seclusion and unbeatable village convenience-complete with sidewalks taking you right to the heart of the action! Perched on a flat, dry, and bathed-in-sunlight .32-acre parcel, the south-facing orientation floods the property with natural light all day long. Whether you choose to reimagine the existing, 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath home or bring your dream team to build a custom masterpiece from the ground up, the possibilities here are endless. Set among a gorgeous tapestry of mature landscaping, meticulous existing homes, and impressive multi-million-dollar new construction, you are investing in a premier street where location is king and the upside is limitlessly bright. Just minutes from the train, vibrant village life, and top-rated New Canaan schools.
